About the Desert Eagle | Kumicho Dragon

As expensive as it is powerful, the Desert Eagle is an iconic pistol that is difficult to master but surprisingly accurate at long range. It has been painted in a marbleized pattern. The Desert Eagle | Kumicho Dragon is a Classified-grade skin in Counter-Strike 2, featuring the Kumicho Dragon finish on the Desert Eagle. With a Classified rarity classification, it has approximately a ~0.64% chance of dropping from case openings.

How to Obtain: The Desert Eagle | Kumicho Dragon can be unboxed from the Operation Wildfire Case. It belongs to the Wildfire Collection.

Float Value and Wear: This skin has a float value range of 0.00 to 0.76. This restricted float range means not all wear conditions are available, which can affect rarity and pricing for specific exteriors. Lower float values within each condition tier produce a cleaner in-game appearance and typically command higher prices.

Price and Market Trends: The Desert Eagle | Kumicho Dragon (Factory New) has a median market price of approximately $130.88, with the lowest listing prices available in the marketplace comparison below. The price has remained stable with minimal movement over the past 7 and 30 days, indicating balanced supply and demand. Across wear conditions, prices range from $20.75 (Battle-Scarred) to $130.88 (Factory New).

Community Rating: The Desert Eagle | Kumicho Dragon has a community rating of 3.9 out of 5 based on 265 votes. This above-average rating suggests the community considers it a solid choice among Desert Eagle skins.

Frequently Asked Questions

What's the difference between Factory New and Minimal Wear for the Desert Eagle | Kumicho Dragon?

Factory New (FN) Desert Eagle | Kumicho Dragon skins have float values between 0.00-0.07, showing minimal to no visible wear. Minimal Wear (MW) floats range from 0.07-0.15, with slight scratches or fading. The price gap between FN and MW varies by finish — some designs like the Kumicho Dragon pattern hide wear better than others, making MW versions a strong value alternative.

Is the Desert Eagle | Kumicho Dragon worth the price?

The Desert Eagle | Kumicho Dragon sits in the mid-to-high price bracket. It features a distinctive Kumicho Dragon design that stands out in-game and maintains good trading liquidity. It's part of the The Wildfire Collection, obtainable from the Operation Wildfire Case, which adds to its collectible appeal. For players who main the Desert Eagle, this skin offers an excellent balance of visual appeal and investment stability compared to budget alternatives.

What is the float value range for the Desert Eagle | Kumicho Dragon?

Float values in CS2 determine a skin's wear level on a scale from 0.00 (perfect) to 1.00 (maximum wear). With a float range of 0.00 to 0.76, this skin has specific wear availability that affects pricing. Lower float values within any condition category (e.g., 0.01 vs 0.06 in Factory New) result in cleaner appearances and typically command higher prices. For high-value trades, always verify the exact float value using inspection tools.

Where is the cheapest place to buy the Desert Eagle | Kumicho Dragon?

Prices for the Desert Eagle | Kumicho Dragon vary across marketplaces due to fees, regional pricing, and seller competition. This skin can be obtained by opening the Operation Wildfire Case or purchased directly from third-party marketplaces. The Steam Community Market charges 15% fees, while third-party markets like Skinport, DMarket, and Buff163 offer lower prices with 2-10% fees. Compare real-time prices in the market comparison table above to find the best deal.

Can I use the Desert Eagle | Kumicho Dragon in competitive CS2?

Yes, all weapon skins including the Desert Eagle | Kumicho Dragon are purely cosmetic and can be used in all CS2 game modes including competitive matchmaking, Premier, and professional tournaments. Skins provide no gameplay advantages or disadvantages - they only change the weapon's visual appearance. Many professional players use skins during official matches, and you'll often see high-value items like this featured in tournament broadcasts.

Is the Desert Eagle | Kumicho Dragon price going up or down?

The Desert Eagle | Kumicho Dragon has remained relatively stable in price recently, with less than 5% movement over the past 7 and 30 days. Stable pricing suggests balanced supply and demand. This can be a good sign for investors looking for low-volatility items, and for buyers it means you're unlikely to overpay. Check the price chart above for longer-term trends.

What collection is the Desert Eagle | Kumicho Dragon from?

The Desert Eagle | Kumicho Dragon is part of the The Wildfire Collection. It can be obtained by opening the Operation Wildfire Case. All skins from the same collection share a rarity hierarchy, which affects trade-up contract possibilities and overall value.

What is the story behind the Desert Eagle | Kumicho Dragon?

The in-game description reads: "As expensive as it is powerful, the Desert Eagle is an iconic pistol that is difficult to master but surprisingly accurate at long range. It has been painted in a marbleized pattern." The Kumicho Dragon finish on the Desert Eagle is a distinctive design that has made this skin a recognizable part of CS2's visual identity.
